03 / A straightforward process

You know painting.
We know websites.

A clear plan. A few conversations.
Something you’ll be proud to put your name on.

The details make the difference.
01

Start with your story.

We talk about your business, your customers, and the work you want more of. Your existing website, photos, and ideas give us a place to start.

02

Build it together.

We bring the words, design, and website together. You review the direction at agreed milestones, so the finished result feels like your business.

03

Make a fresh start.

We check the pages, mobile experience, and enquiry flow before launch. Domain, hosting, and handover arrangements are agreed as part of your project.

05 / A few things to know

Good questions.
Straight answers.

How much does a website cost?

It depends on the pages, content, and functionality your business needs. We start by understanding the scope, then put the work and price in writing before you decide.

How long will it take?

We’ll agree on a timeline once we understand the project. The number of pages, available photos, and time for feedback all help shape a realistic launch date.

What will you need from me?

A conversation about your business, your services and service area, any existing brand materials, and photos of your work. We’ll help organize what’s needed and flag any gaps.

Can I keep my current domain?

Usually, yes. We’ll check your domain setup and plan the switch, including any email services connected to it, before changing anything.

What happens after launch?

Hosting, ownership, updates, and support should be clear from the beginning. We’ll set out the arrangements in your proposal so you know exactly what’s included.

Will a new website bring me more leads?

A better website can make your work easier to understand and your business easier to contact. Enquiries also depend on traffic, your market, and your reputation, so we don’t promise a specific number of leads.
